comment: Generic OBD-II profile for ICE vehicles, generated from the OBDex Mode 01 PID dataset (https://github.com/foerbsnavi/obdex, CC0-1.0) by tools/build_generic_obd2.py. Polls 93 standard PIDs on the functional broadcast address 0x7DF with single-frame responses decoded from 0x7E8 (ECU #1). BYTE OFFSETS (single-frame response): B1 = PCI byte (ISO-15765 single-frame header), B2 = 0x41 (mode 01 + 0x40), B3 = PID, B4.. = data bytes (A, B, ...). The mask/match on B2:B3 (0x41:PID) also rejects multi-frame responses, which is intentional: all polled PIDs answer in a single frame. Intervals are tiered (core driving parameters 1000 ms, the rest 5000 ms); all requests share 0x7DF, so the firmware round-robins them to spread bus load. PIDs that are bitmaps/enumerations or need multi-frame responses (O2 location bitmaps, supported-PID bitmaps, EGT bank frames) are intentionally omitted.
